title: I made a game inspired by GregTech. MiniMachines: Steam to Singularity
author: Askdevin777
selftext:
Development took about 2 weeks using Claude Max x20 for the majority of coding and building. 

The Game is available to download for free on [Itch.io](http://Itch.io) here: [https://kaydedm.itch.io/minimachines-steam-to-singularities](https://kaydedm.itch.io/minimachines-steam-to-singularities)

Icon and in game images were majority made via ChatGPT.  
All coding, animation,  and modeling for the machines was done by Claude via Blender.  
Modeling and animation for the Character was done via [Meshy.ai](http://Meshy.ai) and rigged/animated via Claude in Blender. 

Introduction Video: [https://youtu.be/OFkPjRzRxbM](https://youtu.be/OFkPjRzRxbM)

A cozy, deep factory game. Wake up on a tiny island with stone tools, then build steam engines, electric lines,

belts and drills, launch a rocket, and automate your way across 26 worlds and ten tiers, from the age of steam to the Singularity.

still in active development, all updates are automatically downloaded on startup of the game.

  
Any constructive criticism or ideas to implement are greatly welcomed and appreciated.

I know the factory grindy games aren't for everybody, but i find them relaxing and it successfully scratches the same itch that gregtech and Monifactory did for me.
